items.title_cn: Show HN: I wrote an email app that accepts only one sender per inbox
items.title_en: Show HN: I wrote an email app that accepts only one sender per inbox
items.summary_cn:
Infinite inboxes, including prefixes where you don't have to create inboxes before you use them -- they self create when you add a suffix.

Three types of inboxes: - One sender. Locks to the first domain to send email (except gmail, outlook, etc where it locks to an email account for obivous reasons. It bounces everyone else. - Temporary. Lasts for a while (24h, 7days, etc) then bounces. Received messages stay or go as per your choice. - Prefix. The most powerful. Declare a prefix like &qu
